name: Paz de Ariporo (Colombia)
description: Yellow field with a green triangle at the hoist and a red triangle beyond it, both pointing to the fly.
history: Municipal flag of Paz de Ariporo, a municipality in the department of Casanare, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: larger triangle pointing to the fly
